messages:
maria: FYI prod-eu1 GPUs are backing up, tail latencies jumping and requests are queueing. autoscaler not responding.
ajay: seeing it too — controller logs show repeated ProvisionerError + 'quota_exceeded' then a bunch of 'node notReady' churn.
sre-bot: Alert: autoscaler_high_pending_requests prod-eu1 (fired at 2026-03-18T15:42:16Z) :warning:
sam: Spot eviction storm hit eu1 at ~15:40 — cloud logs show mass terminations, nodes are being recreated but low priority pools still pending.
lee: quick metric dump: desired_replicas=220 actual_ready_nodes=48 pending_pods=830 pending_seconds_avg=95
ajay: interestingly reconciler isn't emitting scale events — it reports headroom >= 0 because some nodepools are reporting capacity via stale cache. I think the cache TTL bumped to 5m after last deploy.
maria: can someone post the recent controller config? did we change zoneAffinity/toleration rules in the last rollout?
ajay: pushing config snippet: ```json
{"topology_preference":"cost_prefer","zone_filter":["eu1-a","eu1-b"],"fallback_on_demand":false,"cache_ttl_sec":300}
```
sam: that `fallback_on_demand:false` is the issue — yesterday's cost tweak prevented on-demand fallback, so when spots evaporated autoscaler refused to request on-demand nodes. ops mistake.
lee: confirmed. set `fallback_on_demand=true` locally and restarting scale-controller. `kubectl -n infra patch deploy scale-controller -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"restarted":"now"}}}}}'`
ajay: controller restarted, but new on-demand pools show provisioning_time ~2m and still warming. we should also shift traffic away from eu1 while nodes warm.
maria: starting partial traffic shift to us-west1 (30%) via canary routing, will monitor error budget. :rocket:
sam: small mitigation: rolling the GPU model to a smaller footprint reduces per-request GPU mem so more concurrency per node. deploying model v2-small to canary slot. deploy-bot: deploy started for model v2-small -> canary (id dpl-872)
lee: good call. Also opened INC-2026-342: "eu1 autoscaler failed to fallback to on-demand after spot eviction" with initial notes and timeline.
ajay: follow-up: we need a postmortem action — two items: (1) revert cost_prefer -> allow fallbacks by default, (2) lower cache_ttl to 30s for topology cache. putting PRs on my queue.
maria: agree. also add a probe in the controller to compare cloud provider capacity vs cache and alert if mismatch > 10%.
sam: traffic shift holding, latencies dropping in canary. new on-demand nodes coming up, GPU pods scheduling now.
lee: autoscaler emitted catch-up scale up events at 15:52 and we now report desired=210 actual_ready=198 after all pods scheduled. still verifying request success rates.
maria: nice work. will keep the channel open until postmortem draft. please add any logs/timestamps to the incident ticket. :thumbsup:
ajay: adding logs and a short RCA blurb to INC-2026-342. thanks everyone.
deploy-bot: uptime-checks passing for canary -> 15/15 checks OK
sre-bot: Alert resolved: autoscaler_high_pending_requests prod-eu1 (resolved at 2026-03-18T15:58:40Z) :white_check_mark:
